title: Factors Affecting Absorption Spectra & Chromophore/Auxochrome Systems

cognitive_progression.level_1_remember: Define fundamental laws, terminology, and bounds of Factors Affecting Absorption Spectra & Chromophore/Auxochrome Systems.
cognitive_progression.level_2_understand: Explain underlying physical mechanisms, instrumentation, and energy transitions.
cognitive_progression.level_3_apply: Solve quantitative analytical calculations using $$\lambda_{\max} = \text{Base Value} + \sum \text{Substituent Increments} \quad (\text{Woodward-Fieser Rules})$$.
cognitive_progression.level_4_analyze: Interpret spectral shifts, evaluate deviations, and troubleshoot analytical anomalies.

pedagogical_boundary.retained_scope: Solvent polarity shifts (hypsochromic blue shift for n->pi* due to ground-state H-bonding stabilization; bathochromic red shift for pi->pi* due to excited-state dipole stabilization), pH effects on ionizable chromophores (phenol vs phenolate bathochromic shift; aniline vs anilinium hypsochromic shift), Woodward-Fieser rules for conjugated dienes and enones, steric hindrance inhibiting coplanarity.
pedagogical_boundary.non_forced_clinical_rationale: Focuses on physical organic chemistry of conjugated systems, solvent polarity dielectric shifts, and pH-dependent chromophore ionization. Drug applications serve purely as chemical structures demonstrating auxochromic resonance.

vision_filtering.policy: Separate core educational diagrams from decorative slide artifacts
